comparison_definition: Every result is conditional on (Earth AOI E, planetary reference AOI P, task profile T, epoch or process H, method version V). Valid narrow claim: at the specified 10 km windows and tested scale, site E resembles reference P on the measured descriptors for task T.
notice: Indices are project-defined bounded indices on the stated measurements. They are not probabilities, confidence levels, percentages of identity, NASA standards or mission-suitability ratings.

formulas.scalar_distance: d_k = |x_E,k - x_P,k|   (same units on both bodies)
formulas.distribution_distance: d_k = W1(F_E,k, F_P,k) = integral_0^1 |F_E,k^-1(u) - F_P,k^-1(u)| du   (equal-area cells, 500 midpoint quantiles)
formulas.family_score: S_g = sum_k a_k|g * s_k   (nonredundant features; a_k|g sum to 1; every required feature must be eligible)
formulas.observed_index: 100 * sum_g w_g I_g S_g / sum_g w_g I_g   (undefined when no family qualifies)
formulas.evidence_coverage: sum_g w_g I_g   (share of the planned profile weight that is measured and comparable)

parameters.d_k: Distance between the Earth and planetary measurement of feature k, in the feature's own units (degrees or metres).
parameters.tau_k: Material-difference tolerance in the same units: the median W1 between unselected pairs of Earth land windows (Earth terrain contrast), accepted only if it is at least 3 times the resolution floor.
parameters.delta_k: Resolution floor: what moving the reference 2 km and changing the DEM product alone produce. Differences at or below it cannot separate sites.
parameters.a_k|g: Weight of feature k inside family g (equal across nonredundant scored features).
parameters.w_g: Planned weight of family g in the task profile. Provisional preferences from analog-evidence-v2, awaiting independent scientific review.
parameters.I_g: 1 when family g passes its comparability and quality rules for both AOIs, otherwise 0 with a recorded reason.

terrain.label: F1 Terrain morphology
terrain.epoch: Present-day surface form (SRTM February 2000; CTX stereo 2006 onward; LOLA 2009 onward).
comparability_rules: Integrity-checked DEM on both bodies, in metres
Same 10 km window, 60 m grid, 1.2 km halo and kernels
At least 90 % valid cells for every scored feature on both AOIs
Tolerance at least 3x the resolution floor
No known contamination of the window

geology.label: F2 Geology and mineralogy
comparability_rules: Verified mineral abundances, lithology or spectral features at the exact AOI on both bodies
True-colour imagery alone does not quantify mineralogy

temperature.label: F3 Thermal environment
temperature.epoch: Present-day climate (not the ancient Jezero lake)
comparability_rules: Same physical quantity (skin, air or subsurface)
Matching spatial support, local time, season and sampling

water_ice.label: F4 Water and ice
comparability_rules: Mapped occurrence with depth, persistence and detection limit at a comparable scale

surface_processes.label: F5 Surface processes
surface_processes.epoch: Active or past aeolian, fluvial, volcanic, ice or impact processes
comparability_rules: Documented process descriptors for both AOIs; similar appearance does not establish a shared process

subsurface_habitability.label: F6 Subsurface, habitability and biology
comparability_rules: Task-specific cave, ice, chemistry or preservation evidence for the exact AOI

field_test_suitability.label: F7 Field-test operations
field_test_suitability.epoch: Present-day access, permits, logistics, soil and rock properties
comparability_rules: Reported separately; never part of a planetary-science index
A 60 m DEM cannot establish wheel-scale mobility, base suitability or landing safety

earth-atacama.reason: The window contains a large industrial complex (pads, buildings, graded ground) visible in Sentinel-2 L2A S2B_MSIL2A_20260927T144729_R139_T19KDP. WorldCover 2021 classes it as bare ground, so it cannot be masked. Replaced by earth-atacama-south, chosen by a rule fixed before its terrain was measured.

terrain_analogy.label: Terrain analogy
terrain_analogy.question: Which processed Earth windows match the reference window's landform shape (slope and relative-elevation distributions) at a 60 m grid?
terrain_analogy.permitted_conclusion: At the specified 10 km windows and the 60 m grid, this Earth window resembles the reference window on the measured terrain features.
terrain_analogy.scope_line: This result covers terrain only. Geology, soil strength and mission suitability have not been established.

balanced_science.label: Balanced science
balanced_science.question: Which Earth windows are the most useful general analogs across landform, materials and environment?
balanced_science.permitted_conclusion: No Balanced science result is given until geology is measured comparably. Terrain findings are shown as partial evidence.
balanced_science.scope_line: Partial evidence only. Geology, water and ice, surface processes and habitability are not measured, so there is no overall result or ranking.

rover_mobility.label: Rover mobility
rover_mobility.question: Which Earth windows are useful for testing rover mobility on terrain like the reference window?
rover_mobility.permitted_conclusion: Broad 60 m terrain context only. No traversability, hazard or safety conclusion.
rover_mobility.scope_line: A 60 m elevation grid cannot see wheel-scale obstacles, rock hazards or soil bearing strength. No rover-mobility conclusion is possible yet.
not_assessed: wheel-scale traversability (needs 1 m or finer terrain)

biosignature_fieldwork.label: Biosignature fieldwork
biosignature_fieldwork.question: Which Earth windows are useful for testing biosignature research methods relevant to the reference site? This makes no claim about life.
biosignature_fieldwork.permitted_conclusion: Not assessed: there is no AOI-level evidence for minerals, depositional process or preservation and sampling conditions.
biosignature_fieldwork.scope_line: Research done elsewhere in a region is context, not evidence about this window. No claim is made that life has been observed on Mars.
not_assessed: minerals and depositional process at this window

mars_base_field_testing.label: Mars-base field testing
mars_base_field_testing.question: Which Earth windows are useful for testing surface equipment under terrain and thermal conditions like the reference site? This is not a landing, construction or base-siting recommendation.
mars_base_field_testing.permitted_conclusion: Comparable field-test conditions only, kept apart from access, logistics, construction, pressure, gravity and radiation.
mars_base_field_testing.scope_line: A terrain result is never base or landing-site suitability. Pressure, gravity, radiation, access, logistics and construction are not assessed.
not_assessed: comparable thermal regime (data fail the audit)
atmospheric pressure, gravity and radiation (unavoidable differences)

mars: Surface pressure: Earth about 1013 hPa, Mars about 6 hPa (CO₂).
Mars has no global magnetic field and a thin atmosphere, so surface radiation is far higher.
Present-day Mars is not the ancient Jezero lake; today's surface records the result of those processes.
moon: The Moon has no atmosphere: no wind or water erosion and extreme thermal cycling.
Lunar polar illumination and permanently shadowed regions have no Earth equivalent.
Lunar regolith forms by impact gardening, not by weathering.

validation_status_short: Experimental method: not yet validated against expert-labelled analogues or field data.
validation_status: Experimental. Tolerances come from Earth terrain contrast and measured resolution limits; the method has not been tested against expert-labelled analogues, negative controls chosen by experts or field outcomes.

compatibility.terrain-v4.0: Historical. Binned W1 (mass at lower bin edges), exp(-0.5 (d/tau)^2), tau 8 deg / 200 m / 30 m / 150 m from Phase 5, four correlated families averaged over 60/120/240 m. Still served at /api/v2/compare.
compatibility.migration: v1.0 differs in: exact quantile W1; ln 2 transform; tau from Earth terrain contrast with a 3x resolution-floor condition; redundant features shown but not scored; 60 m primary grid with 120/240 m as sensitivity; WorldCover built-up exclusion; the contaminated Atacama window excluded and replaced.
